instruction: Fix `apply` in `rpncalc/operators.py` so the `*` operator is actually supported. The `*` case is missing, so multiplying two operands raises `ValueError: unknown operator` instead of returning the product.
gold_patch:
diff --git a/rpncalc/operators.py b/rpncalc/operators.py
--- a/rpncalc/operators.py
+++ b/rpncalc/operators.py
@@ -7,6 +7,8 @@
         return a + b
     if op == "-":
         return a - b
+    if op == "*":
+        return a * b
     if op == "/":
         return safe_divide(a, b)
     raise ValueError(f"unknown operator: {op}")
